provenance.method: Bounded review of current nidirect Access to Work (NI) information; Northern Ireland scope preserved.

name: Access to Work (NI) — nidirect
description: Northern Ireland employment-support route providing information about Access to Work (NI) and practical workplace help.
intended_use: Using the correct Northern Ireland work-support route rather than assuming the Great Britain Access to Work scheme applies unchanged.
audience_or_context: Disabled people working or preparing to work in Northern Ireland; current programme eligibility and support rules apply.
limitations: Northern Ireland programme; it must not be merged with Great Britain Access to Work rules.
ND Oracle does not decide eligibility or funding.
cost_or_access_notes: Official public information; programme conditions should be checked at time of application.
